items.summary: Refactor the backend comment pool in `backend/main.mo` to store each comment as a record with a unique `commentId` (Nat), `text` (Text), and `status` (`#available` or `#used`). Replace the existing flat list/count structure with this status-based stable store. Provide a migration that converts all existing pool comments to `#available` status so no data is lost.

Rewrite the `generateSingle` function in `backend/main.mo` so it atomically selects the first `#available` comment, immediately sets its status to `#used` in the same synchronous operation, and returns `#ok(text)`. If no `#available` comment exists, return `#err("Pool is empty")`. No two concurrent calls may receive the same `commentId`.

Rewrite the `generateBulk` function in `backend/main.mo` to implement strict all-or-nothing semantics. Count the number of `#available` comments. If the count is >= requested N: atomically mark exactly N comments `#used` and return `#ok([text])` with all N texts. If count < N: return `#err("Only " # Nat.toText(count) # " comments left. Reduce quantity.")` and mark zero comments used. No partial fulfillment.

Update the `getPoolStats` backend function in `backend/main.mo` to return the count of comments with `status = #available` as the live inventory count, and the total number of comments (regardless of status) as the total pool size.

Update `SingleGeneratorView.tsx` to display a modal popup (with an OK button to dismiss) when `generateSingle` returns an `#err` variant. The modal must show the error message text. After a successful generation, immediately refetch pool stats so the displayed 'Comments left: X' count is accurate.

Update `BulkGeneratorView.tsx` to display a modal popup (with an OK button to dismiss) when `generateBulk` returns an `#err` variant. The modal must show the error message (e.g., 'Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.'). Remove all partial fulfillment UI messaging. After any generate attempt (success or error), immediately invalidate or refetch the pool stats query so 'Comments left: X' is accurate.
